Policy clock: first unit audio starts → trainee presses Enter. Goal: generate the traffic-stop call within 45 seconds.

First transmission plays from New Traffic Stop. After you acknowledge, the continuation plays automatically.

The 45-second policy clock and grading stay the same at every level. Radio pacing and cadence change; Realistic also adds light field-style delivery variation.

Samantha is the preferred Clear Training voice. Daniel, Karen, Moira, Rishi, and Tessa remain available as understandable alternates when installed on the device.

Structure

TS UNIT LOCATION;TAG;STATE;VEHICLE

Mobile autocorrect is disabled for this field where the browser permits it.

Scoring: Unit, Tag, State and Format are all-or-nothing. Location gives 50% credit per correct roadway. Vehicle credit is split evenly between Color + Make, plus Body when one is transmitted.

Florida stays blank: TS 410 1/46;123ABC;;WHT NISS
